t: A keychain-size game console you can program yourself.
steps: Buy a Thumby from the TinyCircuits store or DigiKey.
Find a micro USB cable that carries data. Charge-only cables will not connect.
Open the Thumby Code Editor in Chrome or Edge.
Plug in the Thumby and click connect in the editor.
Load a game from the Thumby Arcade and play it.
Switch to Blockly mode and build a simple moving sprite.
meta: Wild Open. From $29.95. A few stores.
